_comment: Proud, and it eats meat: insects, birds and small animals (Fantastic Beasts; Buckbeak eats dead ferrets and rats in Prisoner of Azkaban). HippogriffEntity only accepts food, touch or a rider from someone it has bowed back to; this file is the trust that follows. Riding needs 25. The betrayal penalty is the steepest in the mod because insulting a hippogriff is the one thing canon is explicit about.
